description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Planar Void trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Planar Void trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
